lede: Norwood's Board of Trustees holds a public hearing Thursday night on a resolution that could remove a sitting Planning Commission member — that's rare anywhere, and worth watching in a small town where these relationships run deep. Mountain Village Council is also meeting Thursday to take a second-reading vote on housing authority fee language and adopt the 2027 MVHA fee schedules. On the lighter side, the 17th Telluride Horror Show kicks off Friday at the Sheridan, and the San Miguel Watershed Forum on Tuesday is worth your time if you have a water project in the works.

notable.stake: Council votes to adopt 2027 MVHA fee schedules affecting housing authority residents.
Public hearing on formal removal of a sitting Norwood Planning Commission member.
Public hearings on new construction for Telluride's large Shandoka Lot redevelopment project.
